200 Returned if the details for the specified tag category were retrieved successfully.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The unique identifier (UUID) of the category.
string
The name of the category. The name must be unique within a Tenable
Vulnerability Management instance.
string
The description of the category.
string
An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time on which the category
was created, for example, 2018-12-31T13:51:17.243Z .
string
The name of the user who created the category.
string
An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time on which the category
was last updated, for example, 2018-12-31T13:51:17.243Z .
string
The name of the user who last updated the category.
boolean
Indicates whether the tags in this category are reserved (cannot be
updated). This is a read-only field set by the system.
tag_category_uuid
required
uuid
name
description
created_at
created_by
updated_at
updated_by
reserved

— 429
